title: Riven's Starlight Picnic Run
description: A little dusty-turquoise pick-up and his tiny field-mouse friend settle a breezy hilltop picnic, watch soft shooting stars, then rest above nearby farmhouse lights.

Riven.role: Main character; a compact family pick-up truck
Riven.color: Dusty turquoise body with an ivory roof, warm tan bumper, and a small cream shooting-star emblem on each door
Riven.bodyShape: Compact short-bed pick-up with four chunky dark tires; no arms or hands
Riven.face: Exactly two warm brown eyes located in his two round headlights; no windshield eyes and no other eye-like lights; friendly dark grille smile
Riven.accessories: Picnic gear may appear in his bed; no lettering, logos, or numbers

Tansy.role: Supporting character; a tiny field mouse
Tansy.color: Cinnamon-brown fur with a cream belly
Tansy.bodyShape: Tiny field mouse with rounded ears and little paws only; always much smaller than Riven; no clothing
Tansy.face: Dark brown eyes and a gentle expression

settingBible.Starlight Meadow: A rolling grassy hilltop stargazing meadow with smooth stones, low wildflowers, a small telescope, picnic blanket, thermos, purple hills, valley water, and nearby farmhouse lights
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded pick-up and mouse, golden evening fading to starry night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Riven keeps dusty turquoise body, ivory roof, tan bumper, shooting-star door emblems, and eyes only in the two headlights.
Tansy stays a much smaller cinnamon field mouse with cream belly and no clothing.
Page 2 shows Riven already parked with the blanket already spread.
Page 7 keeps the thermos in the truck bed.
Pages 8 and 11 may include an extra shooting star.
Page 9 does not have Riven looking up and does not call the star diamond-shaped.
Page 12 avoids cups and does not say the telescope points at the moon.
Page 13 uses sunset-gold light and does not require the blanket in the truck bed.
Page 15 mentions nearby farmhouses rather than tiny distant ones.
No rescue, danger, lettering, logos, or numerals in artwork.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: One evening, Riven climbed the gentle hill with a picnic blanket tucked safely in his truck bed.
pages.illustrationScene: Dusty-turquoise pick-up Riven climbs a gentle grassy hill at golden evening with a folded picnic blanket and brass thermos in his bed.
pages.continuityNotes: Riven alone on page 1; Tansy absent. Headlight eyes only.

pages.text: At the hilltop, Riven had already parked, and Tansy waved from the blanket spread beside a tiny telescope.
pages.illustrationScene: Parked Riven sits on the hilltop while Tansy waves from a checkered picnic blanket already spread beside a tiny telescope.
pages.continuityNotes: Art shows Riven already parked and the blanket already spread on page 2.

pages.text: Just then, an evening breeze lifted one corner of the blanket high into the air.
pages.illustrationScene: A gentle breeze lifts one corner of the picnic blanket while Riven and Tansy watch calmly.

pages.text: Riven tried another spot, but the playful breeze followed them across the meadow.
pages.illustrationScene: The picnic is moved to another nearby meadow spot while a blanket corner flutters again; Riven and Tansy stay amused.
pages.continuityNotes: Small breeze problem continues across the meadow.

pages.text: Tansy noticed four smooth stones resting beside the wildflowers.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny cinnamon mouse Tansy notices four smooth stones resting beside low wildflowers on the hilltop.
pages.continuityNotes: Four stones available to hold the blanket.

pages.text: They placed one smooth stone on each corner, and the blanket finally stayed still.
pages.illustrationScene: Riven and Tansy settle the picnic blanket with one smooth stone on each corner so it stays still.

pages.text: The warm thermos stayed cozy in Riven's truck bed while Tansy turned toward the first star.
pages.illustrationScene: Brass thermos remains in Riven's truck bed while Tansy sits by the telescope looking toward early stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Art keeps the thermos in the truck bed on page 7.

pages.text: One by one, more stars appeared above the purple hills, and a soft shooting star slipped by.
pages.illustrationScene: More stars fill the purple twilight sky above the hills while a soft shooting star streaks past Riven and Tansy.
pages.continuityNotes: Allow an extra shooting star in the sky on page 8.

pages.text: Tansy pointed to a bright star sparkling high above the meadow.
pages.illustrationScene: Tansy points toward a bright sparkling star while Riven faces forward on the hilltop, not looking up.
pages.continuityNotes: Riven is not looking up; do not call the star diamond-shaped.

pages.text: Then a slow silver shooting star slipped quietly over the meadow.
pages.illustrationScene: A slow silver shooting star slips quietly across the sky above the hilltop meadow.
pages.continuityNotes: Another gentle shooting star passes overhead.

pages.text: Riven and Tansy made one gentle wish as another soft shooting star drifted overhead.
pages.illustrationScene: Riven and Tansy rest by the picnic while another soft shooting star drifts across the sunset-gold sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Allow an extra shooting star on page 11.

pages.text: The warm picnic grew quiet and still beneath the glowing moon.
pages.illustrationScene: Riven and Tansy rest quietly by the picnic blanket and telescope under a glowing crescent moon; telescope aims toward the horizon.
pages.continuityNotes: Do not mention cups or the telescope pointing at the moon.

pages.text: Together they returned the smooth stones beside the flowers in the warm sunset-gold light.
pages.illustrationScene: In warm sunset-gold light, Tansy returns smooth stones beside wildflowers while Riven waits nearby; blanket need not be in the truck bed.
pages.continuityNotes: Sunset-gold lighting; do not require the blanket to be back in the truck bed.

pages.text: Tansy curled into a cozy grass nest while Riven parked nearby beneath the stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Tansy curls into a cozy grass nest near Riven as he rests parked beneath the stars.

pages.text: Riven's headlights grew sleepy as he whispered goodnight to the starlight meadow and the nearby farmhouses.
pages.illustrationScene: Sleepy Riven rests on the hilltop with Tansy asleep nearby, crescent moon above, and nearby farmhouse lights glowing in the valley.
pages.continuityNotes: Farmhouses are nearby rather than tiny and distant; both rest calmly.
